source_units.text: I have volunteered to help a small collection team read its pest-monitoring records.
Cover these exact topic labels: "Quarantine Checks", "Sticky Trap Logs", "Pest Evidence Recognition".
Give each one at least 20 minutes over the whole plan.
Finish all scheduled study no later than 2027-02-05, inclusive.
